policy_upcoming.what_happened: Temporary regulations were issued concerning a new nonrefundable Federal tax credit for qualified contributions to scholarship granting organizations.
policy_upcoming.effect: A new nonrefundable Federal tax credit becomes available for qualified contributions to scholarship granting organizations in 2027 and later taxable years.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: Final rules set forth requirements for price transparency reporting for non-grandfathered group health plans and health insurance issuers.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your employer health insurance plan has new price transparency reporting requirements that become effective on December 7, 2026.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_calendar.label: FHFA conforming loan limit for next year — expected late November
policy_calendar.note: The cap on a conforming (non-jumbo) mortgage, and the line between a normal rate and a jumbo one. FHFA has announced it in the last days of November each year, and the new limit applies to loans made from January 1.

tech.summary: Google DeepMind researchers unveiled AlphaGenome 2, an AI model aimed at understanding how DNA changes impact cells to identify disease causes and treatments.
Google DeepMind has mathematically verified key parts of Signal's encryption using an AI-powered process, hinting at more practical formal verification in the future.
An individual using 48 AI agents and NASA Lidar data successfully discovered an unmapped Maya pyramid in 72 hours, demonstrating advanced AI capabilities in archaeological exploration.

world.summary: US envoys are set to meet separately with President Putin in Moscow and President Zelenskyy in Dublin following some progress in peace talks.
Millions participated in Spain's first general strike in 14 years, protesting soaring housing prices ahead of upcoming parliamentary elections.
Consultant doctors in England have called off a planned two-day pay strike to allow for formal negotiations with the government.
Hundreds of schools in Italy and the UK were evacuated after receiving bomb threats, amidst growing concerns about hybrid threats.

us.summary: The Supreme Court ruled that border wall construction can continue in West Texas while a lawsuit challenging the plan proceeds.
A House Oversight Committee report concluded that the federal government failed to hold Jeffrey Epstein accountable over decades.
Swatters are increasingly using AI technology to create synthetic voices and sound effects for fake emergency calls to law enforcement, making them more believable.

science.summary: Congo's Ebola outbreak has exceeded 11,000 cases, highlighting the severity of the disease's spread in the country.
An analysis found that the antidepressant escitalopram was more effective at preventing relapse compared to other pills, including Prozac.
